ns2:section.sectionText: This section requires lab enrollment as well. This section is for students who will take CS 233 for James Scholar Honors Credit. Students not wanting to take CS 233 for Honors Credit should enroll in CS 233 AL1 or AL2. In general, students wanting to take CS 233 for Honors Credit should seek the advice of their college to be sure they are following the rules for Honors Credit as determined by their college. Any student who is not a James Scholar but wanting honors credit can email undergrads@cs.illinois.edu to request access. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
